posts.text:
A support chat with a face is one script tag away. Concierge puts a rigged 3D avatar in the corner of your page. A visitor asks, the answer streams in, and the avatar starts speaking the first sentence while the rest is still arriving.

In the reel it is asked how to install itself, and it answers from the page it is sitting on.

When a visitor asks, the widget reads the live page (title, headings, nav and content) plus any facts you curate, and the answer streams back from a free-first inference chain, with failover across providers. Whatever your page says today is what it knows today.

three.ws/concierge

No account, no crawler setup, no per-seat pricing. The widget is open source, and you can add it as a script tag, a web component or an npm package.

Voice comes built in: push-to-talk speech input and browser-native speech output.
